title: Canonical DVR scalar transport of the augmented strict quotient tower
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R$, an adic datum $d$ on $R$, a scheme $T$, a coefficient comparison $C$ of [def-sf-open-quotient-koszul-models], and a calculus $S$ of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. There exist natural isomorphisms from the completed-adic quotient reduction after $C$ to the scalar-restricted $S$ reduction tower, and from its total derived limit to the scalar-transported actual coefficient limit. The latter extends the ordinary comparison normalized by every projection. On each flat-term K-flat complex $Q$, a single strict quotient tower $B$ and augmentation $\Delta Q\to B$ compute both reductions, with the prescribed tensor-generator, transition, counit and total-limit unit equations in OpenDvrAugmentedTowerComparison. In particular the completed-adic completion unit, followed by these two comparisons, equals $C(u^S_P)$ for every derived object $P$. No completeness hypothesis or countable-product exactness is assumed.

source.place: Tags 07A6, 0D6E and 0941; strict tensor augmentation and derived constant/limit unit.

proof.text: Apply openDvrLimitComparison for the canonical normalized inverse-limit comparison, proved from the universal right-derived square and ordinary projection formula. Apply openDvrAugmentedReductionComparison relative to that limit model. Assemble its tower, representative and unit with the proved rlim and limit_model. The structure fields are definitionally the required original fields.
